messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx responses for /v1/generate (hosted-api-prod) — 3m avg error rate 16% (threshold 1%). Pager sent to SRE Rotation.

Alice Tran: I’m on it. Acknowledged the page — will triage. Can someone grab logs and start a timeline?

Samir Chen: grabbing logs now. Saw a surge of 502s from nginx LB to runtime pool. Posting a head of the log:```[2026-04-15T10:19:22Z] runtime-3 - ERROR - kvcache miss: key=abc123, backend timeout=1201ms
[2026-04-15T10:19:23Z] nginx - 502 upstream prematurely closed connection
[2026-04-15T10:19:24Z] runtime-5 - WARN - high p99 latency: 2.6s```

Priya Patel: note: dedicated capacity for customer X pinned to runtime-5 earlier today for rollout. Could be noisy co-tenancy?

Javier Morales: checking metrics in Console -> Per-route. I see latency spike around 10:18Z and a drop in available runtimes in that AZ. Looks like autoscaler failed to add nodes.

Alice Tran: hypothesis 1: autoscaler didn't provision due to quota error. hypothesis 2: KV cache backend (redis-cluster-2) got overloaded causing downstream timeouts. Priya, can you confirm dedicated placement?

Priya Patel: confirmed — customer X pinned to runtime-5 in us-west-2a. but the 502s affect the whole /v1/generate pool, not just that runtime.

Samir Chen: running quick checks:```kubectl get pods -n runtime-prod -o wide | grep CrashLoop``` -> nothing obvious. ```kubectl top nodes | grep us-west-2a``` shows one node at 98% CPU. Autoscaler events:```FailedCreate: quota exceeded for pods: resourcequotas/rt-prod-pool```

incident-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-0415-01. Severity: Sev2. Priority: High. Conference bridge: +1-555-0100 pin 1234.

Alice Tran: mitigation plan: (1) divert new traffic to fallback model variant via routing rules, (2) scale up ephemeral pool in us-west-2b, (3) enable short-term per-key rate limiting to protect KV. Applying steps 1 and 3 now.

Javier Morales: routing change applied: set route policy for /v1/generate -> model-variant: gen-v2-fallback (latency tradeoff) for 30m. Verify with curl: ```curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .status``` -> returns 200 on my test.

Samir Chen: enabled per-key soft throttling (50r/s) on edge. KV timeout adjusted from 1200ms -> 700ms to fail fast.

Alice Tran: good. start building timeline here. I’ll put an initial timeline and ask everyone to add entries: TIMELINE:
- 10:17:52Z oncall-bot: alert triggered (5xx > 1%)
- 10:18:05Z Alice: acknowledged page
- 10:18:20Z Samir: observed 502s from nginx -> runtime pool
- 10:18:40Z Javier: autoscaler failed to add node (quota event)
- 10:19:00Z Priya: noted dedicated placement for customer X
- 10:19:30Z Alice: routing fallback to gen-v2-fallback applied
- 10:19:50Z Samir: soft throttling and KV timeout adjusted
- 10:22:10Z incident-bot: INC created and conf bridge up

Priya Patel: adding: 10:20:15Z — observed Redis 5xxs and slow responses; master CPU spike (top: 95%).

Elena Kwan: drafted statuspage update (below). Please review and approve for publish. We should avoid naming affected customers until confirmed.

Elena Kwan: ```STATUSPAGE DRAFT: We are currently investigating elevated error rates for the Redwood hosted generation API (/v1/generate). Users may experience increased error responses or intermittent failures. Our SRE team has applied temporary routing fallbacks and throttles to reduce customer impact while we remediate. We will provide updates every 30 minutes. Impact: partial degradation to text generation service in us-west region.```

Alice Tran: approve with one change: add expected next update time (30m). I'll post once we confirm stabilization.

Samir Chen: traffic drop noted after routing change: 5xx rate down to 5% at 10:25Z. Not fully stable. Collecting logs for RCA. Sharing a link to the log bundle: https://logs.redwood.internal/bundles/1764506789 (internal only).

Javier Morales: I'm going to attempt a controlled scale: request +2 nodes in us-west-2b and add capacity via reserved pool. Command: ```gcloud compute instances create-instances --zone=us-west2-b --count=2 --machine-type=n2-standard-16``` (ops-only). Will coordinate with infra.

SRE Rotation: handing off at 11:00Z — Samir will remain as primary through the handoff. Alice, can you summarize current state for next oncall?

Alice Tran: Summary for handoff: current mitigation = routing to gen-v2-fallback + per-key throttles + KV fast-fail. 5xx rate down from 16% -> 4.8%. Autoscaler quota issue persists; infra is provisioning extra nodes in us-west-2b. No confirmed customer-impact list besides transient failed requests. Next steps: wait for new nodes, monitor KV latency, prepare RCA timeline doc post-incident.

Priya Patel: adding a note for RCA: capture commit SHA of runtime image deployed to runtime-5 (could be unrelated). ```docker inspect runtime:prod | jq .Config.Labels.commit``` -> pushing SHA to timeline: sha: a1b2c3d

Alice Tran: please drop any console snapshots/links and short notes here for the RCA meeting. Also, everyone add a one-line hypothesis and whether it's actionable now. I'll collect and synthesize.

Samir Chen: hypothesis: overloaded redis master + failed autoscale -> cascading upstream timeouts. Actionable: scale read replicas + increase redis CPU, but that's medium-term; immediate: throttle ingress and route to fallback (done).

Javier Morales: hypothesis: quota misconfiguration on node pools preventing autoscaler -> actionable: request quota bump and re-run provisioning (in progress).

Elena Kwan: communications plan: (1) post interim status on status.redwood.com with the approved draft, (2) email Ops/Account execs for customers with high SLAs, (3) full RCA + customer impact table within 48 hours. I’ll assemble the stakeholder list — ping me any customer calls I should join.

Alice Tran: agreed. We should also prepare a short note for Sales: customers with Dedicated may have seen rate-limits if pinned runtimes were in affected AZ. @Priya can you prepare the list of pinned customers?

Priya Patel: will do, sending CSV to Elena in 10m.

incident-bot: Update: incident severity remains Sev2. Next automated check in 30m.

SRE Rotation: handoff 11:00Z completed. Samir primary, Alice on second pager. Leaving the channel open for timeline entries.

Alice Tran: final note for this thread: once we mark stable, we'll convert this thread into the RCA workspace — timeline will be copied to the RCA doc and I'll schedule the postmortem meeting for tomorrow 14:00Z. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

[end of thread]
